skillFull: At regular intervals, Creamy Cappuccino creates Cappuccino Potions and Cappuccino Buff Potions on regular Jellies alternatively, adding more points to Yellow Bear Jellies. Cappuccino Potion restores Energy and Cappuccino Buff Potion slows down the Energy drain for a certain duration. Regardless of which Potion you acquire, Yellow Bear Jelly Party will be activated briefly. The higher the level, the more Energy is restored from Cappuccino Potions, the slower the Energy drain from Cappuccino Buff Potions, and the more points for Yellow Bear Jellies.
story: "Cappuccino with lots of cream, please!" Cappuccino Cookie collected all his stamps for free coffee on his coupon at the Cookie's favorite coffee shop near the courthouse. For all the stamps came Creamy Cappuccino! Just looking at this Pet's smile and its amazing cinnamon scent puts Cappuccino Cookie's mind at ease, and now he finds himself pouring less coffee, even when cases are piling up. A perfect companion for a prosecutor, indeed!

costumes.name: Summer Cherry Punch
costumes.info: The nights at the resort are even brighter and more enchanting than the days! Creamy Cappuccino has adorned itself with colorful flowers and cherry decorations. The Pet is renowned for helping tired vacationers shake off their sleepiness. Careful not to mistake it for a refreshing fruit punch, as it carries a delightful but strong coffee aroma that might catch you by surprise!
